releases.body:
Sessions now start OFF; run /mushroom to enable.

- /mushroom refuses to enable while Ponytail is active and asks for /ponytail off first
- Unreadable state is reported instead of guessed as OFF
- Publish is gated on version, files, clean tree, and tag checks

First public release.

- Always-on coding rules, injected into normal turns, tool continuations, and compaction
- Per-session ON/OFF, saved in plugin storage
- /mushroom, /mushroom-help, /mushroom-review
- Warns when Ponytail is active instead of changing its global state
- Install: opencode plugin add mushroom-mentor
